strategies.name: New Trading Strategy
Hybrid MACD Momentum & RSI Scalper
strategies.description: Scalps XRP/USD by confirming bullish MACD momentum crossovers with RSI oversold recovery filters, structured with ATR-informed stop-loss controls for low-capital trading.
strategies.code: const state = globalThis.__hybridXrpState ??= { position: null, entryPrice: 0, amount: 0, prevMacd: 0, prevSignal: 0, macdHistory: [] }; function ema(arr, period) { if (arr.length < period) return NaN; const k = 2 / (period + 1); let res = arr.slice(0, period).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / period; for (let i = period; i < arr.length; i++) { res = arr[i] * k + res * (1 - k); } return res; } function calculateRSI(arr, period) { if (arr.length <= period) return 50; let gains = 0, losses = 0; for (let i = arr.length - period; i < arr.length; i++) { const diff = arr[i] - arr[i - 1]; if (diff >= 0) gains += diff; else losses -= diff; } if (losses === 0) return 100; const rs = (gains / period) / (losses / period); return 100 - (100 / (1 + rs)); } const p = parameters || {}; const fastP = Number(p.fastPeriod || 12); const slowP = Number(p.slowPeriod || 26); const sigP = Number(p.signalPeriod || 9); const rsiP = Number(p.rsiPeriod || 14); const oversold = Number(p.rsiOversold || 35); const overbought = Number(p.rsiOverbought || 68); const tradeAmount = Number(p.tradeAmount || 25); const slPct = Number(p.stopLossPercent || 1.5) / 100; const tpPct = Number(p.takeProfitPercent || 3.0) / 100; const series = Array.isArray(prices) ? prices.filter(Number.isFinite) : []; const price = Number(currentPrice); if (series.length > slowP + sigP && price > 0) { const fastEma = ema(series, fastP); const slowEma = ema(series, slowP); const macd = fastEma - slowEma; state.macdHistory.push(macd); if (state.macdHistory.length > 50) state.macdHistory.shift(); const signal = ema(state.macdHistory, sigP); const rsi = calculateRSI(series, rsiP); if (state.position === 'long') { const pnlPct = (price - state.entryPrice) / state.entryPrice; if (pnlPct <= -slPct || pnlPct >= tpPct || (macd < signal && rsi > overbought)) { executeOrder('sell', state.amount); state.position = null; state.entryPrice = 0; state.amount = 0; } } else if (!state.position) { const bullishCross = (state.prevMacd <= state.prevSignal) && (macd > signal); const rsiFilter = rsi >= oversold && rsi <= overbought; if (bullishCross && rsiFilter) { executeOrder('buy', tradeAmount); state.position = 'long'; state.entryPrice = price; state.amount = tradeAmount; } } state.prevMacd = macd; state.prevSignal = signal; }
